title: Alhambra and Generalife - Awesome Experience!!!
text:
The Alhambra and Generalife Tour was a very rich and rewarding experience. This journey of such an important landmark of Southern Spain and Granada was replete with history, including the importance of Moorish influences without sacrificing the convergence of Muslim, Christian, and Jewish influences. Our tour guide, Christian, provided us with detail, taking care to explain important things to us, while taking great photos of me and my husband!

We highly recommend this tour and Christian if you visit Granada!

Alina and Joseph
author: Alina_S

title: Wonderful tour
text: This was a wonderful tour and we learned ALOT!  However, if you have any mobility issues, the Alhambra is NOT for you.   It has alot of walking on uneven ground...but it is a wonderful experience.   Thanks so much for a fantastic tour!
author: Julie_M
